title: India product identity and listing benchmark
protocol: Single manual annotation pass completed before running any scorer on these cases. Match labels use independently published sources or exact observed pack evidence. Distinct requires a confirmed pack, brand, flavour or formulation difference; materially ambiguous relationships stay unresolved. Information missing from a source stays missing unless an explicit packaging annotation is recorded in the item's evidence.
limits: Convenience sample of India-market grocery catalogue records, independently published product evidence and controlled input variants. It is not a licensed Blinkit, Zepto or Instamart feed, probabilistic calibration sample, independent human consensus, or production accuracy estimate. Some corpus records share Open Food Facts sources. Train and validation are reserved. Controlled rows modify the input only and do not expand observed ground truth.
historyOverlap: No shared family or GTIN with the preceding 47-pair benchmark. Six Open Food Facts codes appeared in the earlier 21-pair archive evaluation. These codes belong to the Everest blends and Kissan sauces and are confined to the training split here.
annotationSpotCheck: A second reviewer independently checked the three observed holdout positive labels and the separate Britannia Bourbon multipack listing before scoring. The rest had one annotator.

Open Food Facts.licence: ODbL 1.0 database, DbCL 1.0 contents, CC BY-SA 3.0 images
Open Food Facts.archives: November 14, 2026 category-quality raw API pages with explicit en:india sales-market tags. Product URLs, image references, original archive paths and SHA-256 are included per record.

Brand and shop pages.usage: Link-only manual product identification evidence. No page or photo redistribution, API ingest, prices, availability, or permission to reuse a feed. Matter-of-fact brand, pack, count and barcode transcriptions only.
